items.narrative:
This audit covers 761 traceability events recorded between 2025-01-03 and 2025-09-23, spanning 551 shipping events, 145 transformation events, 64 first land-based receiving events, and 1 receiving event. All 32 products in scope fall into the definite_on tier of the Food Traceability List, meaning every transaction in this dataset carries full traceability obligations. The business transacts with 29 external trading partners, all rated Band A, and logged 216 internal transfer events over the period.

Five findings are rated high severity and eight are rated medium, for a total of 13 findings. The most pressing issues are: 41 lots flagged for duplicate traceability lot codes requiring review, which undermines the ability to trace product forward or backward with confidence; 6 lots with backward lineage gaps and 1 with a transformation linkage that cannot be resolved; 1 lot with a date-ordering anomaly and 1 with a mass balance discrepancy, both of which signal data integrity problems that regulators will scrutinize. Beyond lot integrity, 209 of 6,785 graded key data elements are missing, yielding a coverage rate of 0.9692 rather than full compliance. Additionally, 2 products—04598767000211 and 04598767000495—are declared as General products in your system yet are classified definite_on by the audit engine, and a traceability plan finding indicates the plan itself needs remediation.

The immediate priority is resolving the 41 duplicate traceability lot codes; your data team should audit the lot assignment sheet to identify where duplicate codes were generated and reissue unique codes with corrected linkages before any further shipments are recorded. Products 04598767000211 and 04598767000495 must have their product master declarations corrected from General products to reflect their Food Traceability List status. The 6 backward lineage gaps and the single transformation linkage gap should be investigated next by tracing each affected lot back through the Transformation KDEs Ingredients and Transformation KDEs Produced sheets. Finally, the 209 missing key data elements should be mapped to their specific critical tracking events and filled before the traceability plan—which itself carries a finding—is finalized and submitted.
